# Leaves Guardian

> Enterprise Baileys Wrapper & Infrastructure Library for WhatsApp Bots built with pure Node.js ESM.

Leaves Guardian abstracts away the complexity of @whiskeysockets/baileys connection lifecycle, session management, multi-step messaging, media pipelines, rate limiting, and memory protection into a clean, modular, and enterprise-grade architecture.

- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaves-guardian
- **Documentation**: https://leavesguardian.enginelabs.my.id/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/ziakholder/Leaves-Guardian

---

## Key Modules & Capabilities

### 1. High-Level Core Client (`LeavesClient`)
- State-machine driven lifecycle (`IDLE`, `INITIALIZING`, `AUTHENTICATING`, `CONNECTING`, `OPEN`, `READY`, `RECONNECTING`, `SHUTDOWN`).
- Deterministic readiness distinction (`OPEN` vs `READY`).
- Zero-crash reconnection engine with exponential backoff and jitter.
- Integrated session recovery and auth credential safeguarding.

### 2. Message Builders (Rich Interactive Payloads)
- `TextMessage`: Fluent templating with variable substitution `setVars({ name: 'User' })`.
- `ButtonMessage`: Interactive quick-reply, URL, and CTA buttons.
- `ListMessage`: Single-select and sectioned interactive menu lists.
- `CarouselMessage`: Multi-card horizontal swipeable carousel with button attachments.
- `AIRichMessage`: Meta AI rich formatting with Markdown, syntax-highlighted code blocks, tables, and citations.
- `CanvasMessage`: WhatsApp HTML5 Mini-App and interactive game canvas rendering with Android fast-edit bypass.
- `MediaMessage`: Unified builder for images, videos, documents, audio, and voice notes.
- `ProductMessage`: Universal product catalog and checkout cards.
- `PollMessage`: Native WhatsApp poll creation with single/multi-choice configurations.
- `RichMessage`: Structured ASCII table layouts, monospace code blocks, and quote tips.
- `EventMessage`: WhatsApp group event invitations with start/end time, call links, and locations.
- `StickerMessage`: Dynamic image-to-WebP 512x512 converter with custom EXIF metadata pack name and author.

### 3. Reliability & Infrastructure Subsystems
- `IngressRateLimiter`: Per-JID sliding-window rate limiter with burst protection and penalty tracking.
- `IngressDeduplicator`: In-memory LRU message deduplicator preventing duplicate event handling.
- `TrafficController`: Outbound message queue with priority dispatching, rate pacing, and backpressure hysteresis.
- `MediaPipeline`: Stream transformer and caching pipeline for fast media delivery.
- `MemoryGuard`: Proactive RSS and heap memory monitoring with automatic GC triggering and store eviction hooks.
- `Watchdog`: Connection liveness monitoring, heartbeat tracking, and zombie socket termination.
- `SmartStore`: Resilient, atomic file-backed JSON key-value store with in-memory cache and namespace support.
- `TerminalManager`: High-security terminal presentation engine with automatic secret redaction and privacy masking.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install leaves-guardian
```

*Requirements: Node.js >= 18.0.0 (Pure ESM)*

---

## Quick Start Example

```javascript
import { LeavesClient, TextMessage, ButtonMessage } from 'leaves-guardian';

const client = new LeavesClient({
  auth: {
    directory: './session',
    method: 'qr'
  },
  printQR: true,
  traffic: { enabled: true },
  rateLimiter: { enabled: true },
  deduplicator: { enabled: true }
});

client.on('ready', ({ user }) => {
  console.log(`Bot connected as ${user.name} (${user.id})`);
});

client.on('message', async (message) => {
  if (message.body === '!ping') {
    await client.sendText(message.from, 'Pong! 🏓');
  }

  if (message.body === '!menu') {
    await new ButtonMessage(client)
      .setBody('Welcome to Leaves Guardian! Choose an option:')
      .addReply('Documentation', 'cmd_docs')
      .addUrl('GitHub', 'https://github.com/ziakholder/Leaves-Guardian')
      .send(message.from);
  }
});

await client.connect();
```
